# v0.5.1 — Notifications, crash reporting, settings polish and a Bitcoin tip

## Desktop notifications

When a scan completes while the window is minimized, a desktop
notification shows the results (toast on Windows, Notification Center
on macOS, libnotify on Linux). Silently skips when no notification
daemon is available (WSL).

## Crash reporting (Sentry, opt-in per LGPD)

Anonymous crash reports through Sentry help find and fix bugs. Strictly
**opt-in** — disabled by default, toggle in Settings → General. No
personal data, file paths, or browsing history is ever sent; the
`beforeSend` hook strips file paths and request data before anything
leaves the machine. Forks and self-builds without the Sentry DSN send
nothing.

## Privacy transparency

- New "Privacy and telemetry" section in the README with the exact data
  collected and never collected
- Settings → About gains a privacy summary with a link to the full
  policy
- Settings → About also gains a "Support development" section with a
  Bitcoin tip address and copy-to-clipboard button

## Settings UI overhaul

- General page redesigned: each option is a card with title,
  description and control side-by-side
- The crash reports toggle is an iOS-style switch (pill with sliding
  knob)
- Settings pages fill the full width and scroll properly on small
  screens

## Other improvements

- Themes: HTTP tarball download (ureq + flate2 + tar, pure Rust) —
  no git required on the user's machine
- Theme update detection via GitHub API with a one-click Update button
- Theme size on disk shown in the themes card
- Download spinner while cloning a theme
- Scan completion moment: ring pulse, count-up reveal, button glow
